episode_backtest.method: one synthetic representative per strategy episode carrying that episode's mean benefit; an episode is consecutive reaffirmations of the same (ticker, strategy, action) within a 4-calendar-day gap — a moved trigger or changed condition does NOT start a new episode; daily capital-weighted benefit is compounded, never arithmetically summed across calls

measures.all: every episode, active and passive — AI track record
measures.active: cut/trim/add timing only — the alpha question
measures.passive: hold/watch only — the underlying's own move, i.e. beta
measures.followed: every executed episode, active and passive mixed
measures.followed_active: executed episodes that were a decision to act

rows.bear: 2x 每日重置、浮亏已吃穿硬止损线 4.4pp，10 年期收益率创 2007 年来新高时把 85% 的美股段押在一只高波动标的上，赔率结构是单向的
rows.attacked_consensus: 攻击的是星舰入轨所以航天敞口该留着这条最强共识；动量是真的，但动量属于 SPCX 那一层，不属于每日重置的 2x 那一层
rows.judge: 单名 85% 对标普 β 3.4 的敞口本身不该存在，这是组合政策执行，叙事强弱不构成保留理由
